by end of turn, it automatically heals the closest ally for 1d4+EM instead. 5–14: +2 movement, pull on attacks, Charged attacks root, temp HP = 1/4 EM. 15–19: All attacks and abilities gain +1 tile to their area of effect. At the end of your turn, all
enemies adjacent to you become Rooted. Temp HP = 1/2 EM. 20+: Choose form.

name: Brian C. – Burst
description: Perform a wide fire slash damaging all enemies within 3 tiles and bringing all small units into a line behind you. Generates a fire shield around you equal to 1/4 max hp roll.

name: Brian C. – Basic
description: Slash all adjacent enemies. After attacking, move up to 4 tiles.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Players roll; sends 2/4/6 seeds accordingly; each ≤14 for 1d4.

name: Dylan – Charged Attack
description: Blast any adjacent unit and gain 1 D4 of Burst Charge. Small Units are knocked back. Damage dealt on charged attacks is multiplied by the number of fire stacks you have. Stacks are cleared on use.

name: Electro Crystal Projection
description: 4 aerial projectiles at the last hitter.

name: Rock · Paper · Scissors
description: Teleport charge (bypass def) ~1d8, ground-smash 1d8 (1-tile radius), scissor slice 1d12 line. Handle bypass on first hit in logic.

name: Tremors
description: Ground waves; walls can block; bypasses defense.

name: Fly-By
description: Targets lowest roll; hits that platform and two adjacent. Bypasses defense and cannot be blocked by walls.

name: Spin
description: Spinning attack; all within 2 tiles.

name: Lacerating Slash
description: Swipe toward the area of the lowest-HP player. Cannot be blocked by walls.

name: God Arrows
description: Arrows fall; hit everyone not in the center-most 3×3.

name: Half Flail Combo
description: Half-circle sweep at closest; knockback (logic).

name: Flail (360)
description: Full 360° sweep within 2 tiles; knockback (logic).

name: Dash
description: Dashes 5 times (4 tiles each) at closest; hits all in path; cannot be blocked; 1d4 per dash.

name: Pushing Mask
description: Pushes a large mask in a 3-wide line at last hitter (≤10 for 1d8).

name: Oushi no Omote
description: Creates a mask that blocks frontal ranged damage for 3 turns.

name: Shadowsword
description: Teleport to lowest HP; 3 slashes in 2×3 around them. First Cryo, next two Anemo; each 1d4 (≤12).

name: Orbital Strike
description: Sky laser on closest; bypasses defense (1d8).

name: Droplet Aid
description: Summons 5 droplets at edges. Each touching boss restores 20% of phase max HP.

name: Shadowrush
description: Dashes 10 tiles to furthest; pulls units within 3 tiles for 1d10 (≤10).

name: Basic Attack

name: Nilou – Burst
description:
Creates a domain of flowing waters around the entire party for 2 turns. While active:
- Nature + Water will trigger twice, healing for 2D8 of health.
- Water + Nature will be corrected by the flowing waters preventing the negative effect from occurring and instead triggering the positive effect.

name: Brian C. – Burst
description: Create an electrical aura around yourself making it so you take ½  damage for 2 turns. All allies attacks will be linked to this aura and a small amount of electrical damage shall be dealt after each of their (and your) attacks.

name: Primordial Shower
description: Arena-wide breath. Shielded targets: no damage. Unshielded may defend ≤17; 1d30.

name: Primeval Spring
description: Spawns 10 attuned rocks randomly across the map.

name: Elemental Breath
description: Breath in a 4-tile semi-circle in front.

name: Tremors
description: Many small waves; walls can block LOS; bypasses defense.

name: Healing Thunder
description: Instantly heals 50% of missing HP.

name: Blast

name: Amber – Burst
description: Throw out a baron bunny taunting all enemies within 4 tiles. Once the first enemy hits it, it explodes dealing large damage in a 3x3 area.

name: Brian C. – Skill
description: Stab the ground causing it to erupt and apply fire to all units within 3 tiles. Small units are taunted for next attack during which you can roll twice and take the better roll. Allies will have their next physical attack roll have +5 added to it.
